pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark-brown regions with medium-soft edge gradients; vertices exhibit a mix of sharp and rounded geometries; relative patch area is largest at the shoulder and decreases toward the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, interconnected light-tan pathways forming a topological mesh; intersections primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff mane presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear indentations or skin folds are visible across the central flank, revealing underlying anatomical structure or textural disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism, likely an oxpecker, is perched on the upper posterior/rump region of the subject.
